x: Charlie Churcher, at Maccabi Stadium, Middle East, walked 2nd to the Palestine Champion, Friedlander, in 3,000 metres race, at beginning of May, and a week later was again 2nd in a one mile event.

At the half distance, Spooner led the Palestine champion, Friedlander, by 6 secs. in 43.30. After an hour his lead was increased to 11 secs., but he then suffered from an attack of cramp and, although making a gallant rally in the closing stages, was unable to again catch Friedlander who eventually won by 35 secs.
On January 31st he won a 3,000 metres walk from scratch in 14mins. 07.5secs.—31 seconds better than the existing record held by Friedlander.
